# User guide

For H0 persistence in a chosen filtration, use
`ScalarNetworkTopology.persistence_diagram("sublevel")` or
`persistence_diagram("superlevel")`. The optional `include_essential="null"`
represents the surviving component with NaN death and infinite persistence;
the default caps its death at the opposite global extremum.

## Filtration API migration

Merge trees are selected by filtration: `compute_merge_tree("sublevel")` gives
the join tree and `compute_merge_tree("superlevel")` the split tree. Ties break
by vertex index (`tie_break="vertex_index"`). Results are cached.
